instruction: merge(intervals) must merge all overlapping intervals and return them sorted by start. It currently returns the input unchanged. Fix it so merge([[1,3],[2,6],[8,10]]) == [[1,6],[8,10]] and merge([[1,4],[4,5]]) == [[1,5]].

files.test_iv.py:
from iv import merge


def test_iv():
    assert merge([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10]]) == [[1, 6], [8, 10]]
    assert merge([[1, 4], [4, 5]]) == [[1, 5]]
    assert merge([[1, 2]]) == [[1, 2]]
